title: Symmetry Fingerprinting with Geometric Learnable Invariants Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.20150v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Geometric deep learning has made available a large variety of structurally equivariant neural network architectures, meaning a particular transformation of their input causes a predictable transformation of their output. But structural equivariance is a very strong inductive bias that can limit performance if chosen poorly. In contrast, choosing an architecture with low geometric bias necessitates data augmentation to obtain correct behavior; extending the training process. We propose a novel neural network architecture that is soft equivariant; we select a set of symmetry groups and during training the network will become equivariant only to those symmetry groups that are appropriate given the training data. After training we can inspect the network to obtain a symmetry fingerprint that will tell us exactly which symmetries ended up being relevant and to what degree. translated_title: 基于几何可学习不变量Transformer的对称性指纹识别
translated_abstract: 几何深度学习已经提供了大量结构等变的神经网络架构，即输入的某种特定变换会引起输出的可预测变换。但结构等变性是一种非常强的归纳偏置，如果选择不当可能会限制性能。相比之下，选择几何偏置较低的架构则需要通过数据增强来获得正确的行为，从而延长训练过程。我们提出了一种新颖的软等变神经网络架构：我们选定一组对称群，在训练过程中，网络将仅对那些在给定训练数据下合适的对称群变得等变。训练完成后，我们可以检查该网络以获得一个对称性指纹，它会确切地告诉我们哪些对称性最终是相关的，以及相关的程度有多大。我们展示了我们的架构和指纹识别过程如何在相关任务中工作。
tldr: 该论文提出一种“软等变”神经网络架构，可在训练中自动只对与数据相关的对称群保持等变，并能通过检查网络获得一个“对称性指纹”，确切揭示哪些对称性相关及其相关程度。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a novel soft-equivariant neural network architecture that automatically becomes equivariant only to symmetry groups relevant to the training data, yielding a "symmetry fingerprint" that reveals exactly which symmetries matter and to what degree.
